title: Megurine Luka — Chalkboard Cherry Blossoms In Bloom〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(What I saw in that SEKAI...
It was so strange and wondrous.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (The girls' thoughts and feelings sparkled so much as they hung from that tree's branches...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this chalk should do rather nicely...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see... It looked something like this...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, Luka.
Can you help me practice...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, what are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this? I'm drawing a tree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A tree? Are you drawing this because we couldn't find a real cherry blossom tree?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this isn't exactly a cherry blossom tree...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, that's it.
Why didn't I think of that before?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
I think we'll get to see cherry blossoms in this SEKAI after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you for tagging along with me like this, everyone. I know you're all tired after practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, what is it that you wanna show us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That'll have to wait until you go into this classroom. So, after you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Finally!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Rin? Len? KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow...! Look at the chalkboard!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! There's a tree!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's actually supposed to be a cherry blossom tree.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A cherry blossom tree? But where are the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, you'll be drawing those in right now with this pink chalk.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, there should be enough for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, it's okay for us to draw on this?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember how we looked all over for a cherry blossom tree and couldn't find one? That's why I decided to draw one on the chalkboard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, by doing this, we can look at it whenever we like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is an amazing idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It really is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Everyone have their chalk ready?
If so, let's make this tree bloom like no other and get our picnic started!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Let's do it!
You're all in, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd like to join in as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I don't mind lending a hand...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I have an idea, Honami.
Instead of drawing them from scratch, why don't you help color them?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For example, I could draw outlines for each flower while you fill them in with pink chalk. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
I think I can handle that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, let's! Our goal will be to make this entire tree bloom♪

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika. How many petals are cherry blossoms supposed to have?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I believe five...
Here, I'll look up some images on my phone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to see it as well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Let's see, cherry blossoms...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright, that's one.
Mind coloring it in for me, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Can you fill mine in too, Honami?
We're gonna need to draw a lot of these to make this entire tree bloom.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm... This doesn't look right.
MEIKO, can you hand me that eraser?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course... Wait, these look perfectly fine to me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They do? It just doesn't seem like they'd grow on a branch like this, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. You're such a perfectionist.
Just look at those two. They're drawing without a care in the world.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki, let's race to see who can draw more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. You're going down, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: Go! Go! Go! Go! Go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! They just keep going and going.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess I should take it easy and let myself draw more freely like them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. We're all free to draw whatever we like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. Now, I have some catching up to do!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll need to keep trying my best as well since I suggested that we do this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see how our cherry blossom tree turns out.)
